title: Hobbies around WKU
paragraphs: My name is Aibek Dosov. I am 19 years old and I am from Pavlodar. I study History at WKU. I love talking to people and learning about their lives. One of my favourite things to do is ask my friends and classmates about their hobbies. Every person at WKU has a unique passion — and today I want to share the hobbies of the most interesting people I know.

My classmate Zarina is from Almaty and she loves cooking. She cooks in the dormitory kitchen every Sunday and makes amazing traditional Kazakh food. She knows how to make beshbarmak, baursaks, and manty from memory — without a recipe! She also bakes chocolate cakes for birthdays. When Zarina cooks, the whole floor of the dormitory smells wonderful. She says: "Cooking is like chemistry — you mix the right things and something magical happens!"

Bekzat from Kyzylorda has only one true passion: football. He trains every day after class for at least two hours. He plays in the WKU university football team and he scores goals in almost every match. He watches international football matches every weekend and studies the techniques of famous players. He wakes up early to run five kilometres before breakfast. Football is not just Bekzat's hobby — it is his dream and his entire life.

Ainur is from Astana and she has an extraordinary hobby — she reads books in five different languages! She reads Kazakh poetry, Russian classic novels, English science fiction, Chinese short stories, and Korean comics. She reads for at least one hour every evening before sleeping. She visits the WKU library three times a week and always borrows four or five books at a time. She says that reading is the cheapest way to travel the world.

Arlan from Astana has two main hobbies that are actually very similar: chess and coding. He plays chess online every day and he practises coding problems on competitive programming websites. He wakes up at 7 am, makes tea, and codes for one hour before breakfast every single morning. He says: "Chess teaches you to think many steps ahead. Coding teaches you to think precisely. Together, they make you unstoppable."

Samal from Karaganda carries her camera everywhere she goes. She photographs the WKU campus, the streets of Uralsk, and the people she meets. She wakes up at 6 am on weekends to catch the sunrise light over the steppe. She posts her three best photos every week on Instagram, where she already has more than 1,400 followers. She says: "Photography is not about the camera — it is about learning to see."

And what about me? My hobby is playing guitar. I play for about one hour every evening in my room. I learned my first three chords when I was 14 years old — I taught myself using YouTube videos. Now I know more than 25 songs and I sometimes play for my friends in the common room. Music relaxes my mind after a long day of reading history textbooks. I play best when I am alone and the dormitory is quiet.

Every student at WKU has a hobby that makes them feel alive. Zarina cooks. Bekzat plays football. Ainur reads. Arlan codes. Samal photographs. And I play guitar. Our hobbies are all different, but they all do the same thing — they give us energy, joy, and a reason to get up in the morning. What is YOUR hobby? Whatever it is, do it with passion every single day!

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Zarina! The whole floor smells incredible. What are you cooking?

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: Baursaks! I make them every Sunday. Do you want some?

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Yes please! How long have you been into cooking?

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: Since I was eight. My grandmother taught me. I cook every Sunday — it relaxes me.

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Amazing! I play guitar to relax. What do you think about Bekzat's hobby?

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: Football? He is obsessed! He trains every day, even in the rain!

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Ha! And Ainur — she reads books in five languages. Can you believe that?

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: I know! She borrows five books at once from the library. Five! I read one a month!

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Different hobbies, different people. That's what makes WKU interesting!

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: Exactly! What is your hobby, Aibek? Besides asking everyone about their lives!

dialogue.speaker: Aibek
dialogue.text: Ha! Guitar. I play every evening. It helps me forget about history exams.

dialogue.speaker: Zarina
dialogue.text: Guitar! You should play for us one evening. We will all come and listen!
